criteria.summary: meta.element.reason cites director:<slot-id> for a pinned Director trait the candidate realises (params.traits any-of, params.required all-of); a default:<ref> kept needs that Director reason too; a reference value is a base, never the reason (R-DIRECTOR-DERIVED).

meta.source.kind is one of params.kinds; every ref is <registry>/<item>@<version> from params.registries or a slot id, never a file path; a registry ref carries a sha256 hash; the licence is one of params.licenses.

The theme candidate carries clossys/<slot>.json as DTCG members on one $type (params.type), with a value for every mode of params.modes, matching cssVars per mode, and provenance per member (params.provenance).
Every .svg file of the candidate passes svg.viewbox (params.viewbox), svg.modes (params.modes), render.small-size (params.smallSize) and svg.no-raster.
Every meta.source.parts[].slot is a Designer slot id under params.layers, none twice; a composition names at least one part.

A candidate carrying meta.backdrop (the descriptor {component, params} riding on the surface's own code candidate) passes only where the slot contract declares a backdrop-placed slot and the descriptor names an adopted record of the Designer backdrop registry, with every param inside that record's schema; a candidate without meta.backdrop is not judged.
